status: BC startup regression fixed on Edge; UE4 post-title scene rendering/performance unresolved
route: Original OHOS Wine / FEX / Legacy DXVK ARM64X / X11

fix.selection: Per-family sampled/filter/transfer and concrete/mutable 2D/3D image capability checks at adapter initialization
fix.fallback: Existing upload-time BC decompression; consistent typed/typeless/view/copy family representation
fix.tradeoff: A partially supported family falls back as a whole; native 2D resources in that family also expand if 3D support is missing. This increases memory use.
fix.exclusions: Existing mapped/RT/UAV/shared restrictions remain. No lossy compression, resizing, feature-bit spoofing or game-specific rule.

probes.coverage: 10 concrete BC formats (2D, seven mips); 5 typeless BC volumes; initialized BC1 depth slices and BC5 UNORM/SNORM GPU sampling

x11Keymap.cause: Installed NCP shim stages server-0.xkm only while another client can cause display :1 selection.
x11Keymap.sourceFix: entry/src/main/cpp/display/ncp/xwayland_child.cpp stages the actual display keymap and handles zero-progress writes.
x11Keymap.deviceWorkaround: Stage the unchanged packaged XKM under server-1.xkm before launch. It is consumed by Xwayland; this is not a persistent fix to the old installed HAP.

game.titleVisuals: Chinese menu, colors and title scene visible

revertedExperiments.mapVisuals: Tutorial image visible; main scene captures black after closing tutorial

nativeVulkanWaylandComparison.postTitleVisuals: Black client area; HUD continues advancing

game.conclusion: No qualified map visibility or playable-performance fix. Black scene and low FPS also observed on the native Vulkan route; current evidence does not isolate a specific shader or driver layer.
